items.title: 〈財報〉甲骨文Q1優預期 雲端基礎設施營收翻倍 盤後漲逾4%
items.title_en: Oracle Beats Q1 Forecast, Cloud Infrastructure Revenue Doubles, Shares Up Over 4% After Hours
paras: 甲骨文(Oracle)(ORCL-US)周四(10日)盤後公布2027會計年度第一季(截至8/31)財報，業績優於市場預期，帶動盤後股價走揚。截至發稿，漲逾4%。
根據公司聲明，甲骨文第一季營收年增近30%。淨利潤為46.8億美元，或每股1.56美元，高於去年同期的29.3億美元，或每股1.01美元。調整後盈餘排除股票薪酬支出。

Q1 財報關鍵數據 v.s. LSEG預估


營收：193.5 億美元 v.s. 191.4 億美元
調整後EPS：1.92 美元 v.s. 1.74 美元


展望第二季，甲骨文預估調整後每股盈餘介於1.85至1.93美元，營收年增率介於30%至34%。LSEG調查的分析師原先預期，調整後每股盈餘為1.89美元，營收為212億美元、相當於年增32%。
甲骨文近期大部分的業務擴張都與資料中心成長有關，公司正試圖在人工智慧(AI)熱潮中取得更大的市占。不過，與超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscaler)競爭對手相比，甲骨文的現金部位較弱，信用評等也較低。目前公司負債高達1,250億美元，自由現金流為負54億美元，去年同期則為負3.62億美元。
第一季資本支出從去年同期的85億美元，大幅增加至285億美元。公司表示，第一季期間已交付850MW的資料中心容量。
第一季雲端營收大增62%，達116.1億美元，高於StreetAccount調查分析師預估的115.1億美元。其中，雲端基礎設施營收更翻倍成長至74億美元，也高於市場預估的70.9億美元。
針對2027會計年度，甲骨文目前預估調整後每股盈餘為8.10美元，營收至少達900億美元。LSEG市場共識則預期每股盈餘為8.07美元，營收為897.6億美元。
甲骨文財務長Hilary Maxson在簡報中表示，公司全年資本支出指引維持不變。
在財報公布前，分析師一直關注甲骨文資料中心擴建是否出現延誤。此前《彭博社》報導，甲骨文位於新墨西哥州一座資料中心所需的天然氣管線工程進度落後。
Maxson在簡報中表示，「目前我們所掌握的任何資訊，都不會讓我們認為新墨西哥州或其他任何據點，相較於我們在2027財政年度展望中所列時程有所延誤。」
甲骨文執行長Clay Magouyrk在與分析師舉行的電話會議中表示，公司目前正在新墨西哥州申請空氣排放許可。
甲骨文軟體業務於第一季貢獻55.5億美元營收，年減約3%，也低於StreetAccount預估的56.1億美元。
截至第一季末，甲骨文剩餘履約義務(RPO)達6,640億美元，高於StreetAccount預估的6,306億美元。這項數字包括已簽約但尚未認列的營收、遞延營收，以及尚未收取的帳款。
Magouyrk表示，「我們在第一季新增簽署超過300億美元的AI合約，而且不需要甲骨文額外投入資本。」
第一季期間，甲骨文推出了面向人力資源團隊的AI代理，也取得美國國防部一項超過10年的合約，總價值最高達70億美元。
截至周四收盤，甲骨文股價今年以來下跌22%，同期標普500指數則上漲約11%。
paras_en: Oracle (ORCL-US) on Thursday (the 10th) released its fiscal 2027 first‑quarter earnings (ended August 31) after market close, posting results that beat expectations and sending the stock up more than 4% in after‑hours trading as of this writing.

According to the company’s statement, Oracle’s first‑quarter revenue grew nearly 30% year‑over‑year. Net income was $4.68 billion, or $1.56 per share, up from $2.93 billion, or $1.01 per share, a year ago. The adjusted earnings exclude stock‑based compensation expenses.

Key Q1 figures versus LSEG estimates: Revenue $19.35 billion vs. $19.14 billion forecast; Adjusted EPS $1.92 vs. $1.74 forecast. For Q2, Oracle projects adjusted EPS of $1.85‑$1.93 and revenue growth of 30%‑34% year‑over‑year. LSEG analysts had originally expected adjusted EPS of $1.89 and revenue of $21.2 billion, about 32% growth.

Most of Oracle’s recent expansion has been tied to data‑center growth as the company seeks a larger share of the AI boom. However, compared with hyperscale cloud rivals, Oracle’s cash position is weaker and its credit rating lower. The firm carries $125 billion of debt and posted negative free cash flow of $5.4 billion, versus a negative $362 million a year ago.
First‑quarter capital expenditures jumped sharply to $28.5 billion from $8.5 billion a year earlier. Oracle said it delivered 850 MW of data‑center capacity during the quarter.

Cloud revenue surged 62% in Q1 to $11.61 billion, topping StreetAccount analysts’ estimate of $11.51 billion. Cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubled to $7.4 billion, also above the market’s $7.09 billion forecast.
For fiscal 2027, Oracle now expects adjusted EPS of $8.10 and revenue of at least $90 billion. LSEG consensus forecasts EPS of $8.07 and revenue of $89.76 billion.
Chief Financial Officer Hilary Maxson said in the presentation that the company’s full‑year capital‑expenditure guidance remains unchanged.

Before the earnings release, analysts were watching for possible delays in Oracle’s data‑center build‑out. Bloomberg had reported that the natural‑gas pipeline work for a New Mexico data center was lagging.

Maxson told investors, "Based on any information we have at this time, we do not believe the New Mexico site—or any other location—is delayed relative to the timelines outlined in our fiscal 2027 outlook."
CEO Clay Magouyrk said in the analyst call that Oracle is currently applying for an air‑emissions permit for the New Mexico facility.
Oracle’s software segment generated $5.55 billion in Q1 revenue, down about 3% year‑over‑year and below StreetAccount’s estimate of $5.61 billion.

At quarter‑end, Oracle’s remaining performance obligations (RPO) stood at $664 billion, above StreetAccount’s estimate of $630.6 billion. This figure includes signed but unrecognized revenue, deferred revenue and accounts receivable yet to be collected.
Magouyrk noted, "In Q1 we signed more than $30 billion of AI contracts, and they do not require additional capital investment from Oracle."
During the quarter Oracle launched an AI assistant for HR teams and secured a U.S. Department of Defense contract lasting over ten years, with a maximum total value of $7 billion.
By Thursday’s close, Oracle’s stock was down 22% year‑to‑date, while the S&P 500 index was up roughly 11% over the same period.

items.title: 英特爾力挺新創挑戰HBM市場 美光股價承壓
items.title_en: Intel Backs Startup Challenging HBM Market, Micron Stock Under Pressure
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，獲英特爾 (INTC-US)、超微 (AMD-US) 與格芯 (GFS-US) 投資的晶片新創公司 Kepler Computing 週三 (10日) 對外揭露新型記憶體技術與量產規畫，其新型記憶體技術有望緩解產業供應瓶頸，並挑戰目前廣泛應用於人工智慧 (AI) 硬體的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM)。
Kepler 表示，其記憶體採用鐵電材料與 3D 堆疊技術。鐵電材料可在極低電壓下讀寫資料，配合立體堆疊設計，不僅能在固定面積內配置更多晶片，也能縮短記憶體與處理器之間的距離，以較低能耗提供更高頻寬。
除了主張效能可望超越現有 HBM，Kepler 還宣稱，新產品可利用現有半導體設備製造，不必額外採購艾司摩爾 (ASML-US) 的昂貴微影設備。若相關技術順利商業化，可能為目前供應吃緊、價格攀升的記憶體市場帶來新的競爭者。
Kepler 已募得 4.68 億美元，投資人包括英特爾、格芯與超微。美國商務部今年 7 月也承諾提供最高 2.45 億美元，支持該公司的研發工作。
不過，Kepler 的產品距離大規模商用仍有一段距離。公司預計今年稍晚交付首批 HBM 樣品，明年在新加坡擴大生產，並於 2028 年在美國投產。過去市場也曾出現未能成功商業化的創新記憶體技術，包括英特爾的 Optane 業務。
受 Kepler 公布新型記憶體技術、美債殖利率上揚，以及市場升高對聯準會 (Fed) 升息的預期影響，科技股普遍承壓，美光 (MU-US) 週四重挫近 5%，收每股 977.41 美元。美光過去 12 個月股價已上漲逾 6 倍，波動幅度相對較大。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that chip startup Kepler Computing, which has received investments from Intel (INTC-US), AMD (AMD-US) and GlobalFoundries (GFS-US), disclosed on Wednesday (the 10th) a new memory technology and its mass‑production plan. The new memory technology is expected to ease industry supply bottlenecks and challenge the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) that is widely used in artificial‑intelligence (AI) hardware.

Kepler said its memory uses ferroelectric material combined with 3D stacking. The ferroelectric material can read and write data at extremely low voltage, and the three‑dimensional stack design not only allows more chips to be placed within a fixed area but also shortens the distance between memory and processor, delivering higher bandwidth with lower power consumption.

In addition to claiming performance that could surpass existing HBM, Kepler also asserted that the new product can be manufactured with existing semiconductor equipment, without the need to purchase expensive lithography tools from ASML (ASML-US). If the technology is successfully commercialized, it could introduce a new competitor into a memory market that is currently tight on supply and seeing rising prices.
Kepler has raised $468 million, with investors including Intel, GlobalFoundries and AMD. The U.S. Department of Commerce also pledged up to $245 million in July to support the company’s R&D efforts.

However, Kepler’s product is still some way from large‑scale commercial use. The company expects to deliver the first batch of HBM samples later this year, expand production in Singapore next year, and start manufacturing in the United States in 2028. The market has previously seen innovative memory technologies fail to commercialize, such as Intel’s Optane business.

Following Kepler’s announcement of the new memory technology, rising U.S. Treasury yields and heightened expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, technology stocks came under pressure. Micron (MU-US) fell nearly 5% on Thursday, closing at $977.41 per share. Micron’s stock has risen more than six‑fold over the past 12 months, showing relatively high volatility.

items.title: 別只盯著利率 華爾街策略師：投資人漏看這項好消息
items.title_en: Don’t Just Focus on Rates: Wall Street Strategist Says Investors Are Overlooking This Good News
paras: 芝加哥研究機構 Seaport Research Partners 投資組合策略主管派崔克．帕爾弗里（Patrick Palfrey）表示，在下一輪財報季於 10 月中旬全面展開前，總體經濟與地緣政治消息可能持續牽動金融市場，而投資人或許低估了企業第二季獲利的強勁程度。
帕爾弗里接受《MarketWatch》訪問時指出，標普 500 指數成分股第二季每股盈餘大增 55%；即使剔除未實現收益，增幅仍高達 35%。
他表示，企業獲利成長顯然主要由科技業帶動，尤其是半導體公司，但整體而言，企業獲利基本面依舊非常穩健。
AI投資與能源需求撐起獲利
帕爾弗里將強勁獲利歸功於人工智慧（AI）基礎建設投資，以及持續成長的能源需求；即使排除伊朗戰事推升油價的影響，企業表現仍相當亮眼。
以標普 500 指數成分股中位數計算，第二季獲利成長幅度達 15.5%，帕爾弗里形容這項表現「極為可觀」，也是 Seaport 對股市抱持如此正面看法的核心原因。
他並指出，分析師目前罕見地持續上調企業獲利預估。一般而言，獲利預估通常會從較高水準開始，之後隨著年度或季度推進，在企業公布財報前逐步下修。
帕爾弗里表示，獲利預估如今反而向上修正，堪稱異常現象，幾乎超出以往可能出現的範圍，足以顯示企業基本面有多麼強勁。
高利率壓縮本益比
儘管獲利預期十分重要，投資人仍須決定願意給予多高的估值倍數。帕爾弗里表示，當前較高的利率環境正推升資金成本，並對本益比形成壓力，這也是今年以來市場估值倍數持續下滑的原因之一。
另一項壓抑本益比的因素，則是投資人懷疑目前的獲利環境能否維持如此健康。
他以今年稍早軟體股因市場擔憂遭AI顛覆而劇烈震盪為例指出，當時投資人在尚未深入研究前，便先認定所有軟體公司都會受到衝擊，之後資金才又重新回流這類股票。
工業與運輸股漲勢落後基本面
Seaport 製作一系列圖表，將市場對企業未來每股盈餘預估的三個月變化，與股價同期走勢進行比較，藉此判斷個股漲跌是否合理。
帕爾弗里表示，該公司目前尤其在工業與運輸類股發現價格與基本面脫節的情況。這些公司的基本面加速改善，股價卻未獲得相應回報。他認為，科技業不僅吸納幾乎所有資本支出，也占據投資人的大部分注意力。
利率風險重回投資人視野
Seaport本周與機構投資人舉行電話會議，利率環境成為反覆出現的議題。帕爾弗里表示，過去公司試圖在會議上討論利率時，投資人往往認為問題還能再拖一天；但如今市場終於來到不能忽視的時刻。
隨著利率走高、資金成本受創、本益比下滑，加上人口結構問題，這些因素如今正更深入地進入市場討論。
儘管市場認為美國聯準會（Fed）下周升息的機率約為60%，利率決策仍可能令投資人大感意外。帕爾弗里表示，Fed若公開討論通膨問題及升息必要性，可能對市場構成相當大的衝擊。
在投資人押注AI基礎建設熱潮之際，日常經濟數據對股市的重要性相對有限，但若升息討論浮上檯面，短期內仍可能為股市熱度潑上一些冷水。
paras_en: Patrick Palfrey, head of portfolio strategy at Chicago‑based Seaport Research Partners, warned that before the next earnings season kicks off in mid‑October, macro‑economic and geopolitical headlines will likely keep markets on edge, and investors may be underestimating how strong corporate Q2 profits have been.
Palfrey told MarketWatch that S&P 500 constituents saw a 55% jump in earnings per share in the second quarter; even after stripping out unrealized gains, the increase was still a hefty 35%.
He said the profit surge was clearly driven by the tech sector, especially semiconductor firms, but overall corporate earnings fundamentals remain very robust.
AI Investment and Energy Demand Power Profits

Palfrey attributes the strong earnings to investments in AI infrastructure and a still‑growing demand for energy; even when the oil‑price boost from the Iran conflict is removed, corporate performance looks impressive.
Using the median S&P 500 constituent as a benchmark, Q2 earnings grew 15.5%, a figure Palfrey described as “extremely notable” and the core reason Seaport holds such a positive outlook on the market.
He also noted that analysts are unusually continuing to raise earnings forecasts. Typically, estimates start high and are trimmed as the year or quarter progresses toward the earnings release.
Palfrey said that today’s upward revisions to earnings forecasts are an abnormal phenomenon, almost beyond the range historically seen, underscoring how strong the corporate fundamentals are.
High Rates Compress Price‑Earnings Ratios

While earnings expectations are crucial, investors still have to decide what valuation multiples they’re willing to assign. Palfrey said the current high‑rate environment is lifting capital costs and pressuring P/E ratios, which is one reason valuation multiples have been sliding this year.
Another factor dampening P/E ratios is investors’ doubt about whether the current earnings environment can stay as healthy.

He cited the earlier‑this‑year turbulence in software stocks, when market fears of AI disruption caused sharp swings, and investors prematurely assumed all software firms would be hit before capital eventually flowed back in.
Industrial and Transportation Stocks Lag Fundamentals
Seaport produced a series of charts comparing three‑month changes in market EPS forecasts with contemporaneous stock price moves to gauge whether individual stock moves are justified.

Palfrey said the firm now sees a clear disconnect between price and fundamentals in industrial and transportation stocks. These companies’ fundamentals are improving rapidly, yet their share prices haven’t caught up. He believes tech not only absorbs almost all cap‑ex but also dominates investors’ attention.
Rate‑Risk Returns to Investors’ Radar

Seaport held a conference call with institutional investors this week, and the rate environment kept resurfacing as a topic. Palfrey said that in past calls, investors would often think rate issues could be postponed another day, but now the market has finally reached a point where they can’t be ignored.
With rates climbing, capital costs rising, P/E ratios falling and demographic headwinds, these factors are now penetrating deeper into market discussions.

Even though the market estimates about a 60% chance that the Fed will raise rates next week, the rate decision could still catch investors off guard. Palfrey warned that if the Fed openly debates inflation and the need for a hike, it could have a sizable impact on markets.

As investors bet on the AI‑infrastructure boom, everyday economic data plays a relatively minor role for stocks, but if rate‑hike talks surface, they could quickly dampen market enthusiasm in the short term.

items.title: AI大趨勢尚處極早期！台積電高盛大會最新研判：智能體將把算力需求擴至CPU  N3、CoWoS產能仍非常吃緊
items.title_en: AI Trend Still in Its Very Early Stage! TSMC and Goldman Sachs Latest Outlook: AI Agents Will Expand Compute Demand to CPUs; N3 and CoWoS Capacity Remain Extremely Tight
paras: 台積電財務長黃仁昭(Wendell Huang)日前出席高盛Communacopia + Technology通訊科技大會，就AI產業前景與公司營運布局釋出多項關鍵訊息。高盛會後維持台積電「買進」評等，12個月目標價新台幣3100元，ADR目標價620美元。
《智通財經》報導，高盛歸納會議三大核心：AI仍處於多年大趨勢的極早期，AI Agent將把需求從加速器擴散至CPU；亞利桑那廠推進順利，一期良率已與台灣廠區相當並實現獲利；儘管N2量產爬坡與海外擴張短期稀釋毛利率，管理層仍力拚56%以上長期毛利率目標。
台積電管理層重申，AI正由生成式AI轉向AI Agent，運算需求將從GPU、客製化AI加速器進一步擴及CPU。該公司不僅直接對接下游客戶，也與「客戶的客戶」溝通，據此對產業周期的延續性深具信心；近期與美國雲端服務供應商(CSP)的實地交流更強化這項判斷。
台積電管理層並指出，開源模型疊加運算效率持續提升，將壓低Token成本，擴大AI應用規模與普及度，進而支撐先進晶片的增量需求，台積電已將此納入產能規畫並積極擴產。儘管半導體業仍具周期性，但相較於預測短期波動，辨識底層長期大趨勢更為關鍵。

此外，台積電重申海外建廠兩大出發點：客戶對供應鏈地域多元化的訴求，以及取得適度的政府配套支持。亞利桑那廠一期採用N4技術，已投入營運，良率與台灣廠區相當，品質與可靠度達標，並已實現獲利。管理層視其為重要里程碑，證明台積電能在美國生產與台灣同等品質的晶圓。二期廠將採用N3技術，設備搬入預計很快展開；三期建設已啟動；四期及首座美國先進封裝設施同步推進。此外，台積電新購置可容納額外5至6座晶圓廠的土地，以支撐日前宣布的1千億美元美國投資加碼。
按現行規畫，五年內約30%的N2及更先進製程產能將布局於台灣以外，絕大部分落腳亞利桑那，但最先進技術仍會先在台灣爬坡，海外產線待工藝成熟穩定後才跟進。
台積電管理層還透露，客戶最初僅要求小規模地域分散供貨，隨亞利桑那專案驗證成功，相關需求持續升溫。台積電認為地域供應鏈多元化具備額外價值，打算在產品定價中反映，客戶也愈來愈願意支付溢價。
台積電指出，N3需求格外旺盛。過去新節點推出兩、三年後需求通常下滑，如今該公司仍在擴增N3產能，且預期供給依舊吃緊。先進封裝同樣緊俏，CoWoS產能不足，已開始將部分封裝工序外包給OSAT夥伴。
放眼AI供應鏈，電力供給與記憶體被視為潛在瓶頸；晶圓代工產能本身擴張難度亦高，建廠需時2至3年，後續量產爬坡還要1至2年。
台積電管理層強調，發展先進封裝主要目的在確保並帶動晶圓需求，而非將封裝做成獨立獲利板塊。定價上，台積電不因短期稼動率高而漲價，也不因稼動率暫時走弱而降價，原則是基於所提供價值維持可持續、穩定的報價。
毛利率方面，N2量產爬坡料將稀釋2026年毛利率約2至3個百分點，海外擴張在當前五年期早期稀釋2至3個百分點，後續隨更多海外廠投產擴大至3個百分點。
但管理層深信，紀律性產能規畫、健康稼動率、成本降低、生產率提升，加上反映價值的定價策略，將支持公司達成「56%及以上」的長期毛利率目標並向更高區間靠攏。
最後，台積電管理層重申，財報揭露的AI營收定義範圍較窄，僅統計GPU、客製化AI加速器與記憶體基底裸片；CPU、網路晶片未納入，因無法準確判定終端是否用於AI系統。
隨著AI Agent帶動x86、Arm、RISC-V架構CPU及網路等配套晶片的增量需求，台積電實際與AI相關的業務規模，顯著大於報表揭露的AI加速器收入。在能更精準判别晶片終端用途之前，公司將維持現有統計口徑不變。
paras_en: TSMC CFO Wendell Huang recently attended Goldman Sachs' Communacopia + Technology conference, releasing several key messages about the AI industry's outlook and the company's operational layout. After the conference, Goldman Sachs maintained a "Buy" rating on TSMC, with a 12‑month target price of NT$3,100 and an ADR target of $620.

According to ZhiTong Finance, Goldman Sachs distilled three core points from the meeting: AI is still in the very early stage of a multi‑year megatrend, and AI agents will shift demand from accelerators to CPUs; the Arizona fab is progressing smoothly, with Phase 1 yields comparable to Taiwan and already profitable; although N2 mass production ramp‑up and overseas expansion will dilute margins in the short term, management remains committed to a long‑term gross margin target above 56%.

TSMC’s management reiterated that AI is moving from generative AI to AI agents, expanding compute demand from GPUs and custom AI accelerators further to CPUs. The company not only engages directly with downstream customers but also communicates with their customers, giving it strong confidence in the continuity of the industry cycle; recent on‑site exchanges with U.S. cloud service providers reinforced this view.

Management also noted that open‑source models layered with higher compute efficiency will lower token costs, broaden AI application scale and adoption, and thereby support incremental demand for advanced chips. TSMC has incorporated this into its capacity planning and is actively expanding production. While the semiconductor industry remains cyclical, identifying underlying long‑term megatrends is more critical than forecasting short‑term fluctuations.

TSMC reiterated two main reasons for building overseas fabs: customers’ demand for supply‑chain geographic diversification and the need for appropriate government support. The Arizona Phase 1 fab, using N4 technology, is already in operation with yields and quality comparable to Taiwan and has become profitable. Management sees this as a milestone proving TSMC can produce U.S. wafers of Taiwan‑level quality. Phase 2 will use N3 technology, with equipment moves slated to begin soon; Phase 3 construction is underway; Phase 4 and the first U.S. advanced packaging facility are progressing in parallel. TSMC also purchased land capable of hosting an additional five to six fabs to support the recently announced $100 billion U.S. investment increase.

Under the current plan, about 30% of N2 and more advanced process capacity will be located outside Taiwan within five years, largely in Arizona, while the most advanced nodes will still ramp up first in Taiwan, with overseas lines following once the processes mature and stabilize.

Management disclosed that customers initially requested only modest, geographically dispersed supply, but as the Arizona project proved successful, demand has continued to heat up. TSMC believes supply‑chain diversification adds extra value and plans to reflect this in product pricing, with customers increasingly willing to pay a premium.

TSMC highlighted that demand for N3 is especially strong. Historically, demand for a new node drops two to three years after launch, but the company is still expanding N3 capacity and expects supply to remain tight. Advanced packaging is similarly in high demand; CoWoS capacity is insufficient, prompting TSMC to begin outsourcing some packaging steps to OSAT partners.

Looking across the AI supply chain, power supply and memory are seen as potential bottlenecks; expanding wafer‑foundry capacity is also challenging, with fab construction taking 2‑3 years and mass‑production ramp‑up requiring an additional 1‑2 years.

Management emphasized that the goal of advanced packaging development is to secure and drive wafer demand, not to create a standalone profit center. Pricing-wise, TSMC will not raise prices simply because short‑term utilization is high, nor cut prices when utilization temporarily weakens; pricing is based on the value delivered to ensure sustainable, stable rates.

Regarding margins, the N2 mass‑production ramp‑up is expected to dilute the 2026 gross margin by about 2‑3 percentage points, and overseas expansion will dilute margins by 2‑3 points in the early part of the five‑year horizon, expanding to about 3 points as more overseas fabs come online.

However, management is confident that disciplined capacity planning, healthy utilization, cost reductions, productivity gains, and a value‑based pricing strategy will support the company in achieving its long‑term gross‑margin target of 56% or higher and moving toward an even higher range.

Finally, TSMC’s management reiterated that the AI revenue disclosed in financial reports is narrowly defined, covering only GPU, custom AI accelerator and memory‑base die revenues; CPU and networking chips are excluded because it is difficult to determine whether the end‑use is for AI systems.

As AI agents drive incremental demand for x86, Arm, RISC‑V CPUs and networking chips, TSMC’s actual AI‑related business size is significantly larger than the AI accelerator revenue reported. Until the company can more accurately identify chip end‑uses, it will keep the current reporting scope unchanged.

items.title: 大摩：蘋果定價溫和 摺疊iPhone優先拚銷量、而非利潤率
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: Apple Sets Moderate Prices, Prioritizes Foldable iPhone Sales Over Profit Margins
paras: 摩根士丹利在報告中表示，蘋果(AAPL-US)新款iPhone定價低於預期，包括首款可摺疊智慧手機，顯示公司似乎優先追求銷量增長，而非利潤率。
公司周三將可摺疊iPhone Duo起售價定為1,999美元。蘋果新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)主持發布會，並推出iPhone 18及Apple Watch Series 12。
摩根士丹利表示，iPhone Duo售價低於投資人預期的2,300至2,500美元，且較三星Galaxy Z Fold7起售價低近1美元。該南韓科技巨頭目前主導可摺疊智慧手機市場。
該行指出，定價策略顯示「蘋果正優先推動產品普及，而非最大化短期經濟效益」。「鑑於短期供應增長空間有限，我們不會對該設備推出後迅速售罄感到意外。」
蘋果股價周四(10日)大漲3.56%，今年累計上漲20%。
iPhone 18 Pro及Pro Max版本起售價分別為1,199美元及1,299美元，較去年同類型號上調100美元。
摩根士丹利形容有關加價「相對溫和」，並指若加價200美元，將可抵銷較高成本並有助維持iPhone利潤率。該行寫道：「相反，蘋果似乎更專注於推動整體利潤金額增長。」
根據報告，獲予「增持」評級的蘋果提高舊款iPhone價格，而非採用發布後標準100美元減價策略，意味iPhone產品類別定價將有所上升。
摩根士丹利表示，「蘋果似乎願意承受部分利潤率壓力，以支持換機需求、生態系統參與度及產品配置組合。」
蘋果於7月公布，受iPhone銷售動力帶動，第三財季業績表現強勁，但iPad及服務收入低於市場預期。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley said in its report that Apple (AAPL-US) priced its new iPhone lower than expected, including the first foldable smartphone, indicating the company appears to be prioritizing sales growth rather than profit margins.
The company will set the starting price of the foldable iPhone Duo at $1,999 on Wednesday. Apple’s new CEO John Ternus will host the launch event and unveil the iPhone 18 and Apple Watch Series 12.

Morgan Stanley noted that the iPhone Duo’s price is below investors’ expectations of $2,300‑$2,500 and is almost $1 lower than Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold7 starting price. The South Korean tech giant currently dominates the foldable smartphone market.

The bank said the pricing strategy shows “Apple is prioritizing product adoption rather than maximizing short‑term economic returns.” “Given limited short‑term supply growth, we would not be surprised if the device sells out quickly after launch.”
Apple’s stock jumped 3.56% on Thursday the 10th, up 20% year‑to‑date.
The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max start at $1,199 and $1,299 respectively, $100 higher than comparable models last year.

Morgan Stanley described the price increase as “relatively modest” and said a $200 hike would offset higher costs and help maintain iPhone profit margins. The note added: “Conversely, Apple seems more focused on driving overall profit‑dollar growth.”

According to the report, Apple, which received an “overweight” rating, is raising prices on older iPhone models instead of the usual $100 post‑launch discount, suggesting a rise in pricing across the iPhone product line.
Morgan Stanley said, “Apple appears willing to bear some margin pressure to support upgrade demand, ecosystem participation and product configuration mix.”
Apple disclosed in July that, driven by iPhone sales momentum, its third fiscal quarter performance was strong, though iPad and services revenue fell short of market expectations.

items.title: AI泡沫若爆！惠譽示警美股6個月恐崩35% 美國經濟可能陷衰退
items.title_en: AI Bubble May Burst! Fitch Warns US Stocks Could Crash 35% in Six Months, Potentially Dragging the Economy into Recession
paras: 惠譽評級(Fitch Ratings)警告, 如果人工智能(AI)投資熱潮突然逆轉並引發金融市場劇烈修正, 美國股市可能在6個月內重挫35%, 並將美國經濟推入衰退。不過, 惠譽強調, 這是一項極端下行情境測試, 並非該機構對市場或經濟的基本預測。
惠譽模擬的情境假設, 美國股市大幅拋售同時伴隨海外股市下跌15%, AI投資急遽萎縮以及企業信心明顯惡化。在這種情況下, 美國2027年國內生產毛額(GDP)將萎縮0.6%, 2027年第2季GDP年增率更可能降至負1.5%, 私人資本支出則下滑逾6%。
全球經濟也將受到明顯衝擊。惠譽模型顯示, 全球經濟成長率可能跌破1%, 達到該機構所稱的停滯水準。加拿大與墨西哥GDP受到的衝擊都將超過2%, 中國與歐元區的經濟成長則各損失約0.8個百分點。
在金融政策方面, 惠譽的壓力情境假設美國聯準會將大幅降息325個基點, 以因應金融市場崩跌及經濟衰退。
若以週三(9日)標普500指數收盤價7,636點計算, 假設指數下跌35%, 將降至約4,960點。這意味著美股將從目前高檔進入劇烈熊市, 並可能透過財富效果、企業融資、消費與投資等管道, 將金融市場壓力迅速傳導至實體經濟。
惠譽之所以提高對AI市場修正的關注, 是因為科技投資目前已成為美國經濟成長的重要支柱。惠譽表示, 美國資訊科技投資在2026年第1季對年化經濟成長貢獻了1.4個百分點, 顯示AI與科技相關資本支出的影響力已大幅提高。
此外, 惠譽估計, 美國4家最大科技企業今年合計資本支出將超過7,000億美元。如此龐大的投資規模不僅直接支撐科技業營收與設備需求, 也帶動資料中心建設、半導體設備、電力基礎設施以及就業市場。若科技巨頭突然削減AI支出, 衝擊將不會局限於科技股, 而可能同步波及設備供應商、營造業、能源業及招聘活動。
這項風險也與惠譽近期對全球信用市場的觀察一致。惠譽目前將AI相關市場修正列為全球信用風險的重要來源之一, 並指出AI市場修正與中東地緣政治不確定性可能共同收緊融資條件。惠譽同時認為, 美國消費動能放緩、通膨風險與財政限制都可能放大外部衝擊對信用市場的影響。
從全球經濟角度來看, 惠譽此前的全球經濟展望也指出, AI投資熱潮目前正在抵銷部分能源危機對經濟成長造成的壓力。惠譽6月報告預估, 2026年全球經濟成長率為2.4%, 但同時指出美國資訊科技投資在2026年第1季年增18%, 半導體銷售與資本財進口也受到科技熱潮帶動。這凸顯一旦AI投資動能反轉, 目前支撐全球貿易與經濟成長的部分動力也可能同步消失。
市場目前並未普遍押注惠譽所描述的極端崩盤情境。預測市場Polymarket週四(10日)對年末「AI泡沫破裂」合約的定價約為13%, 交易金額接近300萬美元。該合約要求6項條件中至少有3項在90天期間內發生, 其中包括輝達(NVDA-US)從歷史高點下跌50%, iShares Semiconductor ETF(SOXX-US)下跌40%, 或另一家大型晶片企業股價腰斬。
不過, Polymarket的條件與惠譽情境並不完全相同。惠譽模擬的是美股整體在6個月內下跌35%, 而Polymarket合約即使在標普500未跌至35%的情況下, 也可能因個別AI與半導體股票觸發條件而獲得「Yes」結果, 且其截止日期為12月31日, 時間範圍短於惠譽的6個月壓力測試。
實際市場近期也已出現對AI估值與投資可持續性的疑慮。9月10日美股交易中, 標普500指數下跌0.58%至7,591.75點, 那斯達克綜合指數下跌0.65%, 輝達股價則下跌2.3%, 顯示科技股仍對利率與通膨預期高度敏感。當日油價因中東局勢升溫而大漲逾6%, 同時美國10年期公債殖利率升至3年高點, 進一步壓縮股票估值。
然而, 華爾街目前對美股年底走勢仍維持相對樂觀。巴克萊9日將2026年底標普500目標從7,800點上調至7,950點, 並將2026年標普500每股盈餘預測由337美元上修至365美元。該行指出, 第2季已有86%的492家標普500成分股企業公布優於分析師預期的獲利, 明顯高於長期平均67.5%, 強勁獲利與持續AI投資是其看多市場的主要理由。
巴克萊同時並非完全忽視AI風險。該行在上調指數目標的同時, 也提醒市場仍須留意AI支出的可持續性、偏高的估值、通膨韌性、地緣政治風險以及更偏鷹派的利率環境。換言之, 華爾街目前的主流情境仍是AI投資帶動企業獲利延續, 但一旦資本支出與預期獲利之間出現落差, 高估值科技股可能成為市場修正的主要壓力來源。
其他大型金融機構同樣維持偏多看法。匯豐近期將2026年底標普500目標從7,650點上調至8,100點, UBS全球財富管理則將目標提高至8,100點。匯豐預期2026年下半年標普500企業每股盈餘將成長超過25%, 並認為AI基礎建設投資與企業獲利仍是支撐市場的重要力量。

但AI熱潮背後的金融穩定風險正受到更多關注。國際清算銀行(BIS)總裁Pablo Hernandez de Cos近日表示, AI快速擴張正在帶來新的金融穩定風險。BIS估計, 全球前5大科技企業在2025年至2026年投入AI的資金將超過1兆美元, 到2030年全球AI投資規模可能達到4兆美元。BIS也警告, 部分AI投資透過不透明的債務結構融資, 如果未來AI企業無法實現市場預期的獲利, 金融市場可能面臨更大的脆弱性。
因此, 惠譽的35%股市崩跌情境並不代表AI泡沫即將破裂, 而是凸顯AI投資已從單純的科技產業題材, 演變成影響美國GDP、企業資本支出、金融市場估值與信用條件的重要宏觀經濟變數。只要AI投資持續擴張並轉化為企業獲利, 高估值仍可能獲得支撐; 但若科技巨頭同步削減資本支出, 市場對AI回報率的信心轉弱, 惠譽所模擬的「股市修正→投資下滑→經濟衰退」傳導機制便可能成為市場必須正視的尾端風險。
paras_en: Fitch Ratings warned that if the AI investment frenzy suddenly reverses and triggers a sharp correction in financial markets, US equities could tumble 35% within six months, pushing the US economy into recession. Fitch stressed this is an extreme downside scenario test, not a fundamental forecast for the market or economy.

The scenario modeled by Fitch assumes a steep sell‑off in US stocks accompanied by a 15% decline in overseas markets, a rapid contraction in AI investment and a marked deterioration in corporate confidence. Under these conditions, US GDP would shrink 0.6% in 2027, with Q2 2027 annualised growth potentially turning negative 1.5%, and private capital spending falling more than 6%.

The global economy would also feel a clear impact. Fitch’s model shows world growth could slip below 1%, reaching a stagnation level the agency describes. GDP in Canada and Mexico would be hit by more than 2%, while China and the euro‑area would each lose about 0.8 percentage points of growth.
In terms of financial policy, Fitch’s stress scenario assumes the Federal Reserve would cut rates sharply by 325 basis points to counter the market collapse and recession.

Using the S&P 500 closing level of 7,636 points on Wednesday (the 9th) as a base, a 35% drop would bring the index down to roughly 4,960 points. That would mean US equities moving from current highs into a severe bear market, with wealth effects, corporate financing, consumption and investment channels quickly transmitting financial‑market stress to the real economy.

Fitch is paying heightened attention to an AI‑market correction because technology investment has become a key pillar of US economic growth. The agency noted that US information‑technology investment contributed 1.4 percentage points to annualised economic growth in Q1 2026, showing the growing influence of AI‑related capital spending.

Fitch also estimates that the four largest US tech firms will collectively spend over $700 billion on capital this year. Such massive investment not only underpins tech‑sector revenue and equipment demand, but also drives data‑center construction, semiconductor equipment, power infrastructure and job creation. If the tech giants were to slash AI spending abruptly, the shock would extend beyond tech stocks to equipment suppliers, construction, energy and hiring activities.

This risk aligns with Fitch’s recent observations of the global credit market. The agency now lists an AI‑market correction as a major source of worldwide credit risk and warns that it could tighten financing conditions together with Middle‑East geopolitical uncertainty. Fitch also believes slowing US consumer momentum, inflation risks and fiscal constraints could amplify external shocks on credit markets.

From a global‑economy perspective, Fitch’s earlier outlook noted that the AI investment boom is currently offsetting some of the growth pressure from the energy crisis. Fitch’s June report projected 2026 global growth at 2.4%, while also pointing out that US IT investment grew 18% year‑on‑year in Q1 2026 and that semiconductor sales and capital‑goods imports were buoyed by the tech surge. This highlights that a reversal in AI‑investment momentum could erase part of the engine driving global trade and growth.

Markets are not broadly betting on the extreme crash scenario described by Fitch. The Polymarket prediction market priced the “AI bubble burst” contract for year‑end at about 13% on Thursday (the 10th), with roughly $3 million traded. The contract requires at least three of six conditions to occur within 90 days, including Nvidia (NVDA‑US) falling 50% from its peak, the iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX‑US) dropping 40%, or another large chip maker’s stock halving.

However, Polymarket’s conditions differ from Fitch’s scenario. Fitch models a 35% decline in the overall US market over six months, whereas the Polymarket contract could trigger a “Yes” outcome even if the S&P 500 does not fall 35%, as long as individual AI or semiconductor stocks meet the thresholds. Its deadline is Dec 31, a shorter horizon than Fitch’s six‑month stress test.

Recent market activity already shows doubts about AI valuations and investment sustainability. On September 10, US trading saw the S&P 500 slip 0.58% to 7,591.75 points, the Nasdaq Composite down 0.65%, and Nvidia shares falling 2.3%, indicating tech stocks remain highly sensitive to rate and inflation expectations. Oil prices jumped over 6% that day on heightened Middle‑East tensions, while the US 10‑year Treasury yield rose to a three‑year high, further compressing equity valuations.

Nevertheless, Wall Street remains relatively upbeat on the US market’s year‑end trajectory. Barclays on the 9th raised its 2026 S&P 500 target from 7,800 to 7,950 points and lifted its 2026 EPS forecast from $337 to $365. The bank noted that 86% of the 492 S&P 500 constituents reporting in Q2 posted earnings above analyst expectations, well above the long‑term average of 67.5%; strong earnings and ongoing AI investment are the main reasons for its bullish stance.

Barclays also cautioned that AI risks are not ignored. While raising its index target, the bank warned that markets should watch the sustainability of AI spending, lofty valuations, persistent inflation, geopolitical risks and a more hawkish rate environment. In other words, the prevailing Wall Street view still sees AI‑driven corporate profits continuing, but a gap between capital spending and expected earnings could turn overvalued tech stocks into a key correction pressure point.

Other major financial institutions share a similarly bullish outlook. HSBC recently lifted its 2026 S&P 500 target from 7,650 to 8,100 points, and UBS Global Wealth Management raised its target to 8,100 points as well. HSBC expects S&P 500 companies’ EPS to grow over 25% in the second half of 2026 and believes AI infrastructure investment and corporate profitability remain vital market supports.

But the financial‑stability risks behind the AI boom are drawing increasing attention. BIS President Pablo Hernández de Cos recently said that rapid AI expansion is creating new financial‑stability hazards. The BIS estimates that the world’s five largest tech firms will pour more than $1 trillion into AI in 2025‑26, and global AI investment could reach $4 trillion by 2030. The BIS also warned that some AI funding is being financed through opaque debt structures, which could heighten market fragility if AI firms fail to meet profit expectations.

Thus, Fitch’s 35% market‑crash scenario does not signal an imminent AI bubble burst, but highlights that AI investment has evolved from a pure tech‑sector theme into a macro‑economic variable affecting US GDP, corporate capex, market valuations and credit conditions. As long as AI spending keeps expanding and translates into corporate earnings, high valuations may stay supported; however, if the tech giants simultaneously cut capex and confidence in AI returns wanes, the “market correction → investment pull‑back → recession” transmission mechanism modeled by Fitch could become a tail‑risk that markets must confront.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 PPI推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Rises as PPI Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周四(10日)上漲，美國年度整體生產者通膨加速，推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期。數據公布後，債券市場跌勢進一步加劇，殖利率大幅攀升，也進一步推高借貸成本。
同時，歐洲央行(ECB)如市場普遍預期升息後，歐元走弱。另一方面，市場預期日本銀行(BoJ)即將收緊貨幣政策，日元此前猛烈漲勢也暫告停歇。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.03。
匯市投資人周四焦點集中在美國8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)數據，8月整體PPI月增0.4%、年增5.4%，分別高於市場預期的0.4%與5.3%。此外，7月整體PPI也從原先月增0.1%、年增4.7%，上修至月增0.1%、年增4.8%。
核心PPI則月增0.2%、年增4.6%，市場原先預期分別為月增0.3%與年增4.6%。
PPI報告公布後一天，市場還將迎來受到更高度關注的消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而就在幾天前，美國才公布表現強勁的8月非農就業報告。綜合這些指標來看，美國勞動市場依然具韌性，同時經濟也受到價格壓力困擾。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策。
這種預期也反映在聯準會利率機率上。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)9月16日升息25個基點的機率，目前已升至73%，高於PPI數據公布前的約64%。
PPI數據公布後，美股走低，美國公債殖利率同步上升，債券遭到拋售。10年期美債殖利率最新上升11.8個基點至4.955%，對利率更加敏感的2年期美債殖利率則上升12.9個基點，至4.556%。
債券市場前一個交易日同樣大幅走弱，因市場高度期待的美國財政部國債回購計畫更新，最終令投資人失望。
此外，油價漲勢周四進一步擴大，加劇市場對通膨的擔憂。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨價格突破每桶100美元，為5月21日以來首次。油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗軍事衝突重新升溫推動，雙方此前曾因荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權問題陷入數周僵局。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「與伊朗的戰事正在壓過華府的債券回購努力，因為不斷升高的通膨預期，對區區60億美元的回購規模而言，負擔實在太沉重。」

items.title_en: Inflation Unchecked, Economy Fears Recession! Will ECB Rates Hit 3%? Analysts Clash
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(10日)如預期升息1碼(25個基點)，將存款利率調高至2.5%，為今年第二度升息，以因應美伊戰爭推升能源價格所帶來的通膨壓力。ECB雖未承諾後續行動，但分析師對本輪升息是否已近尾聲看法不一：部分認為年底前可能再度升息，另一些則警告，能源衝擊終將拖累成長，市場押注利率逼近3%可能過頭。
市場反應方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%至約1.159美元，歐元區公債殖利率升至多年高點，歐洲Stoxx 600指數下跌0.7%；油價則大漲逾4%至每桶105.3美元。

鷹派認為升息尚未結束 年底前可能再出手

德意志銀行(DB-US)首席歐洲經濟學家Mark Wall表示，通膨風險正在上升，ECB於12月再次升息的可能性或許已超過按兵不動。不過，ECB仍須謹慎行事，因歐元區經濟過去半年雖展現韌性，天然氣價格迅速上漲造成的負面供給衝擊正逐漸累積，最終勢必傷害成長，問題只在影響程度及何時浮現。
Saltmarsh Economics歐洲經濟學家Marchel Alexandrovich指出，ECB在三個月內第二度升息，並暗示未來幾次會議可能需要進一步緊縮。ECB雖未預先承諾升息，但最新預測顯示，2028年核心通膨仍達2.3%，高於6月預估的2.2%，意味若要讓通膨在中期回到2%目標，可能還需要繼續升息。
摩根大通私人銀行(JPMorgan Private Bank)(JPM-US)宏觀投資策略師Patrick Ernst認為，年底前再升息已不再只是低機率風險。中東衝突再次升級，推動油氣價格明顯上漲、美債遭到拋售，市場對主要央行繼續緊縮的預期也同步升高。
Ernst表示，ECB本次升息符合預期，但真正重要的是決策聲明仍為進一步緊縮保留空間，顯示能源引發的通膨風險依然存在，「這次升息並不是利率上限」，後續走向將高度取決於地緣政治局勢。
標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)(SPGI-US)歐洲、中東及非洲首席經濟學家Sylvain Broyer也表示，這次升息不只是預防性措施。歐洲通膨前景在夏季期間已經惡化，不僅供給衝擊增加，需求也愈來愈可能推升物價，因此ECB可能必須把利率調至具有限制性的水準，現階段不能排除繼續升息。

成長風險逐漸浮現 市場押注3%恐怕過頭

施羅德(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees則持較審慎看法。他指出，能源價格上漲將使整體通膨維持高檔，但核心通膨目前仍受控制，內需也正在轉弱；能源與融資成本同步上升，可能進一步壓抑歐元區經濟，2027年受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
Rees認為，儘管ECB聲明及經濟預測偏向鷹派，但再次升息的門檻仍高，本次行動更像本輪最後一次升息，而非長期升息周期的起點。除非經濟成長與通膨再次顯著加速，市場不應直接認定利率將朝3%邁進。
Quilter Cheviot固定收益研究主管Richard Carter表示，ECB面臨的平衡難題愈來愈棘手。歐元區部分地區成長仍然脆弱，決策官員必須在抑制通膨與避免進一步打擊經濟之間權衡。停滯性通膨雖尚未成為基本情境，但成長轉弱與通膨壓力重燃的組合，已愈來愈難以忽視。
Aviva Investors利率主管Ed Hutchings認為，ECB眼前首要任務確實是控制通膨，因此市場預期還會升息並非沒有道理。不過，在ECB已升息兩次、市場又反映超過兩次後續升息的情況下，投資人的緊縮押注可能已走得太遠。
富達國際(Fidelity International)歐元區經濟學家Conor Parle則提醒，天然氣及燃料價格上漲將促使ECB密切觀察物價壓力是否擴散。近期熱浪及供應鏈影響可能推高食品通膨，薪資追蹤指標也顯示薪資成長略微加速，決策官員將關注是否出現能源衝擊擴散至其他價格的早期跡象。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 10th) raised rates as expected by one quarter-point (25 basis points), lifting the deposit rate to 2.5%, marking its second hike this year to counter inflation pressure from higher energy prices driven by the US‑Iran war. The ECB did not pledge further action, and analysts are divided on whether this round of tightening is near its end: some think another hike could come before year‑end, while others warn that the energy shock will eventually drag down growth and that markets may be over‑betting on rates approaching 3%.

In market reaction, the euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to about $1.159, euro‑area sovereign yields rose to multi‑year highs, the European Stoxx 600 slipped 0.7%, and oil surged more than 4% to $105.3 a barrel.

Hawkish voices say the tightening is not over and another move may come before year‑end. Deutsche Bank (DB‑US) chief European economist Mark Wall said inflation risks are rising and the odds that the ECB will hike again in December may now exceed the odds of holding steady. Still, the ECB must act cautiously because, although the euro‑area economy has shown resilience over the past six months, the negative supply shock from rapidly rising natural‑gas prices is accumulating and will eventually hurt growth; the question is how severe and when it will materialise.

Saltmarsh Economics European economist Marchel Alexandrovich noted that the ECB’s second hike within three months hints that further tightening may be needed in upcoming meetings. While the ECB has not pre‑committed to more hikes, its latest forecasts show core inflation still at 2.3% in 2028, up from a June estimate of 2.2%, implying that bringing inflation back to the 2% target in the medium term may still require additional rate rises.

JPMorgan Private Bank (JPM‑US) macro investment strategist Patrick Ernst said a rate hike before year‑end is no longer a low‑probability risk. The renewed escalation of the Middle‑East conflict has pushed oil and gas prices sharply higher, U.S. Treasuries have been sold off, and market expectations for continued tightening by major central banks have risen in tandem.

Ernst added that the ECB’s move was in line with expectations, but the crucial point is that the policy statement still leaves room for further tightening, showing that inflation risks from energy remain. “This hike is not a ceiling on rates,” he said, and the path forward will depend heavily on geopolitical developments.

S&P Global Ratings (SPGI‑US) Europe, Middle East and Africa chief economist Sylvain Broyer also said the hike is more than a precautionary step. Europe’s inflation outlook worsened over the summer, with both supply shocks intensifying and demand increasingly likely to push prices up, so the ECB may have to lift rates to a restrictive level and cannot rule out further hikes at this stage.

Schroders global economics head David Rees took a more cautious view. He noted that higher energy prices will keep overall inflation elevated, but core inflation is still under control and domestic demand is weakening; the simultaneous rise in energy costs and financing costs could further suppress euro‑area growth, with the impact especially pronounced in 2027.

Rees argued that although the ECB’s statement and forecasts lean hawkish, the threshold for another hike remains high, and this move looks more like the last hike of the current cycle rather than the start of a prolonged tightening period. Unless growth and inflation accelerate markedly again, markets should not assume rates will march toward 3%.

Quilter Cheviot fixed‑income research head Richard Carter said the ECB’s balancing act is becoming increasingly tricky. Growth remains fragile in parts of the euro area, and policymakers must weigh curbing inflation against avoiding further damage to the economy. Stagnating inflation has not yet become a baseline scenario, but the combination of weakening growth and rekindling inflation pressures is becoming harder to ignore.

Aviva Investors rates head Ed Hutchings said the ECB’s immediate priority is indeed to rein in inflation, so market expectations of further hikes are not unfounded. However, after two hikes already and market pricing in more than two additional moves, investors’ tightening bets may have gone too far.

Fidelity International euro‑area economist Conor Parle warned that rising natural‑gas and fuel prices will make the ECB watch closely for any spread of price pressures. Recent heatwaves and supply‑chain issues could lift food inflation, and wage‑tracking indicators show a slight acceleration in pay growth, prompting policymakers to watch for early signs that the energy shock is spilling over into other price categories.

items.title: 〈台幣〉買匯力道轉強 貶值4.3分收在31.548元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar Buying Pressure Strengthens, Depreciates 4.3 Cents to Close at 31.548
paras: 新台幣今(10)日升貶互見，午盤過後貶勢擴大，終場收在31.548元，貶值4.3分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值放大至19.39億美元。
新台幣今以31.53元、貶值2.5分開出後，雖一度來到31.49元，但隨後買匯力道轉強，午盤後新台幣越走越低，最低來到31.581元，全日高低價差9.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，韓元貶值近0.2%，新台幣收貶0.14%，泰銖貶近0.1%，日元和星元貶0.05%左右，人民幣平盤附近波動，而美元指數小跌0.05%，市場瀰漫高度觀望聯準會動態的氣氛。
國泰證期研究部指出，台灣 8 月出口年增 41%，金額創單月新高，AI 需求支撐半導體與伺服器營收展望，惟傳產復甦不均，成本壓力仍須關注，大額貿易順差則有利支撐台幣匯率。
統一投顧則分析，台股基本面支撐力道極強，8 月AI 伺服器供應鏈 8 月營收全數締造新猷，展現強韌獲利動能，緊接著輝達管理層出席高盛科技大會，有望釋出下一階段 AI 需求的樂觀展望，惟地緣政治與油價、債市風暴未歇，短線盤面難免受到牽制。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (the 10th), with depreciation expanding after the midday session and closing at 31.548, a loss of 4.3 cents. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage firms saw transaction volume rise to US$1.939 billion.

The NTD opened at 31.53, down 2.5 cents, briefly fell to 31.49, but buying pressure soon strengthened. After the midday session the currency kept sliding, reaching a low of 31.581, with a total intraday range of 9.1 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won weakened by about 0.2%, the NTD fell 0.14%, the Thai baht slipped nearly 0.1%, the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar each lost roughly 0.05%, the Chinese yuan hovered near flat, and the U.S. dollar index slipped 0.05% as markets remained highly cautious about Federal Reserve moves.

Citi Securities’ research team noted that Taiwan’s August exports grew 41% year‑on‑year, hitting a record monthly total. AI demand underpins a positive outlook for semiconductor and server revenues, though recovery in traditional industries is uneven and cost pressures remain a concern. A large trade surplus, however, supports the NTD’s exchange rate.

Unified Investment Advisory analyzed that Taiwan’s equity fundamentals are very strong, with AI‑related server supply‑chain revenues in August all hitting new highs, demonstrating robust profit momentum. Following Nvidia’s management appearance at the Goldman Sachs Technology Conference, optimism about the next phase of AI demand is expected. Nevertheless, geopolitical tensions, oil price volatility, and turmoil in the bond market persist, keeping short‑term market moves constrained.

items.title: 貝森特自稱莊家 對日元與美股意味著什麼？
items.title_en: Biden Claims to Be the House: What It Means for the Yen and US Stocks
paras: 美國財長貝森特向來直言不諱，但他周二晚間在南方衛理公會大學商學院發表的談話，可能是其從政以來態度最強硬的一次。
貝森特談到的，不只是美國財政部近期為支撐日元所採取的干預行動，也包括美方在阿根廷上次大選前，為穩定披索所做的努力。
曾任總體經濟交易員的貝森特表示：「每當有人說，『財長這是在冒險』，我要說，這正是我夢寐以求的局面。我掌握不對稱資訊，現在莊家是我。」
他接著說：「因此，當我們出手干預日元時，我非常清楚日本政府、日本央行及日本決策官員接下來會怎麼做。你想跟我對賭，儘管來。」
到目前為止，美方的外匯干預已取得成效；相較之下，財政部宣布將買進長天期美債後，殖利率僅短暫回落。貝森特介入債市的做法，也遭到其恩師、知名投資人德魯肯米勒（Stanley Druckenmiller）批評。
美日聯手干預前，美元兌日元一度逼近164，目前已回落至約153，最新跌幅約0.32%。
高盛分析師普里沃羅茨基（Rich Privorotsky）在報告中指出，貝森特這番談話帶來的次級效應，才是影響股市的關鍵。市場擔心，隨著日元升值，原本借入低利率日元、再投入其他資產的投資人，將不得不縮減甚至完全平倉，亦即所謂的日元套利交易可能加速退場。
普里沃羅茨基表示：「當以日元融資的套利交易解除，資金回流日本債券與股票時，市場會發生什麼事？」他指出，標普500指數和大型科技股近期在缺乏明顯基本面利空的情況下，走勢卻異常沉重。值得留意的是，部分槓桿與套利部位可能正逐步從市場消退。
瑞銀全球財富管理首席經濟學家唐納文（Paul Donovan）則表示：「只有當日元貶值是由投機因素造成時，賭場的比喻才成立。如果干預前的日元匯價是由基本面驅動，那麼更貼切、儘管較少人熟悉的比喻，應是英國1992年的匯率機制危機。在這種情況下，貝森特應該宣稱：『我就是拉蒙特。』」
拉蒙特（Norman Lamont）當時擔任英國財政大臣，曾試圖讓英國留在歐洲匯率機制內，但最終未能成功。
paras_en: US Treasury Secretary Biden is known for speaking bluntly, but his remarks on Tuesday night at the Business School of Southern Methodist University may be the toughest stance he’s taken in his political career.
Biden discussed not only the Treasury’s recent intervention to support the yen, but also US efforts to stabilize the peso before Argentina’s last election.

Former macro trader Biden said, "Whenever someone says, 'The Treasury is taking a risk,' I reply that this is exactly the scenario I’ve dreamed of. I have asymmetric information, and now I am the house."
He added, "So when we intervene in the yen, I know exactly what the Japanese government, the Bank of Japan and Japanese policymakers will do next. If you want to bet against me, go ahead."

So far the US foreign‑exchange intervention has shown results; by contrast, after the Treasury announced it would buy long‑term US bonds, yields only fell briefly. Biden’s move into the bond market was also criticized by his mentor, famed investor Stanley Druckenmiller.
Before the US‑Japan joint intervention, the dollar‑yen rate briefly approached 164, now it has slipped to about 153, a recent decline of roughly 0.32%.

Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky noted in a report that the secondary effects of Biden’s comments are the real driver for equities. The market worries that a stronger yen will force investors who borrowed cheap yen to fund other assets to unwind or fully close those positions, accelerating the exit of yen‑carry trades.

Privorotsky said, "When yen‑funded arbitrage unwinds and capital flows back into Japanese bonds and stocks, what will happen to the market?" He pointed out that the S&P 500 and large‑cap tech stocks have been unusually heavy despite a lack of clear fundamental downside, and that some leveraged and arbitrage positions may be gradually disappearing from the market.

UBS Global Wealth Management chief economist Paul Donovan said, "The casino analogy only holds if yen depreciation is driven by speculation. If the pre‑intervention yen rate was fundamentally driven, a more apt, though less familiar, comparison is the 1992 UK exchange‑rate mechanism crisis. In that case, Biden should claim: 'I am Lamont.'"
Norman Lamont was the UK Chancellor at the time who tried to keep Britain in the European Exchange Rate Mechanism but ultimately failed.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Shows Minor Fluctuations, Market Focuses on Central Bank Meetings
paras: 美元周三(9日)變動不大，市場焦點持續落在近期大幅走強的日元。外匯市場參與者正為關鍵的時刻做準備，歐洲央行(ECB)本周將公布利率決議，聯準會(Fed)與日本銀行(BoJ)將於下周公布決策。
美國公債市場同樣受關注，財政部公布備受期待的公債回購操作更新後，規模令投資人失望。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報98.83。
美國財政部宣布將回購60億美元、到期年限10年至20年的美國公債，高於先前的20億美元，消息公布後市場拋售美債，美國公債殖利率大幅上升。
美國財政部上月曾表示，將把公債回購規模提高至至少40億美元，但媒體報導此前市場預期規模至少會達到100億美元。
美國10年期公債殖利率上升3.5個基點至4.839%。在財政部公布消息前，殖利率僅上升1.2個基點至4.816%。對利率更加敏感的美國2年期公債殖利率則上升2.7個基點至4.425%。
財政部的回購行動原本被視為一項意外的干預措施，目的是限制美國公債殖利率持續飆升的走勢，而美債近期一直遭遇大規模拋售。
此次美債拋售受到多重因素推動，包括油價飆升引發的通膨疑慮、企業為支應人工智慧基礎建設而大舉發債所帶來的市場擔憂，以及對美國國債規模持續膨脹的疑慮。
布魯金斯研究院經濟研究資深研究員Robin Brooks表示，「試圖透過公債回購等方式，人為壓低長期殖利率的問題在於，如果市場認為回購規模太小，殖利率反而會跳升。這顯示市場底層的上行壓力非常強勁。」
目前市場正密切等待周四公布的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)及周五公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)，以尋找進一步的利率線索。如果通膨數據高於預期，可能使市場對聯準會下周升息的預期明顯升溫。
日元持續徘徊逾七個月高點
日元已成為主要貨幣中表現最亮眼貨幣，光是9月以來就上漲4%。本月初開始的強勁漲勢，周二一度推動日元升至152.89兌1美元的高點。周三日元延續升勢，美元兌日元下跌0.2%，至153.63。
日元受到日本銀行政策收緊預期及市場廣泛猜測日本政府可能再次干預匯市等因素支撐。金融市場幾乎已確定日本銀行將於9月18日升息25個基點，交易員也認為，日本銀行總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)可能暗示年底前還會進一步推動貨幣政策正常化。
LPL Financial技術策略師Adam Turnquist周二表示，「日元的漲勢反映出基本面與技術面真正發生轉變，日銀正進一步走向政策正常化，同時突破原有趨勢。投資人應密切關注152這個關鍵價位，若日元明確突破該支撐並進一步升值，可能加速日元漲勢、迫使更多空頭回補，並重新引發日元套利交易平倉的風險，進而對包括美國公債在內的全球資產產生連鎖影響。」
本周稍早公布的官方數據顯示，日本8月外國證券持有量創紀錄減少878億美元。外匯存底的大幅下降，直接為東京規模達15兆日元(976.7億美元)的匯市干預行動提供資金，其中部分行動是與美國同步進行。
其他貨幣方面，歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1629美元。
歐洲央行幾乎已被市場一致預期，周四將升息25個基點。
德意志銀行Jim Reid表示，「市場確實可以討論，在供給衝擊之下，歐洲央行是否應該繼續升息……但市場顯然認為，央行的政策反應函數與能源價格高度相關，近期油價與天然氣價格上漲，使市場對最終利率的定價達到3%。」
他補充，「因此，明天升息基本上已經確定，但接下來的情況就會變得更加複雜。如果能源價格維持在目前水準，經濟成長應該會受到影響，但到目前為止，實際影響遠沒有市場原先預期的那麼大，因此歐洲央行面臨的高度不確定性必須受到重視。」

paras_en: The dollar changed little on Wednesday (the 9th), with market attention still on the yen, which has surged sharply in recent weeks. Forex participants are preparing for a pivotal moment as the European Central Bank (ECB) will announce its rate decision this week, and the Federal Reserve (Fed) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) will release their decisions next week.
The U.S. Treasury market is also in focus; after the Treasury released an eagerly awaited update on its bond repurchase operations, the size disappointed investors.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 98.83.

The U.S. Treasury announced a repurchase of $6 billion of Treasury bonds with maturities of 10 to 20 years, higher than the previously announced $2 billion. After the news, the market sold off Treasuries, and Treasury yields jumped sharply.
Last month the Treasury said it would raise the repurchase size to at least $4 billion, but media reports noted that the market had previously expected the size to be at least $10 billion.

The 10‑year Treasury yield rose 3.5 basis points to 4.839%. Before the Treasury’s announcement, the yield had risen only 1.2 basis points to 4.816%. The more rate‑sensitive 2‑year Treasury yield climbed 2.7 basis points to 4.425%.
The repurchase action was originally seen as an unexpected intervention aimed at curbing the continued surge in Treasury yields, as Treasuries have recently faced large‑scale selling.

The recent Treasury sell‑off was driven by multiple factors, including inflation worries sparked by soaring oil prices, market concerns over corporations issuing massive debt to fund AI infrastructure, and doubts about the ever‑expanding size of U.S. government debt.

Robin Brooks, senior economist at the Brookings Institution, said, "The problem with trying to artificially lower long‑term yields through repurchases is that if the market thinks the repurchase size is too small, yields can actually jump. This shows that the underlying upward pressure in the market is very strong."

The market is now closely awaiting Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) and Friday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) for further rate clues. If inflation data comes in hotter than expected, expectations for a Fed rate hike next week could rise sharply.
The yen continues to hover near a seven‑month high.

The yen has become the best‑performing major currency, up 4% since September. A strong rally that began early this month pushed the yen to a high of 152.89 per dollar on Tuesday. On Wednesday the yen kept climbing, with USD/JPY down 0.2% to 153.63.

The yen is being supported by expectations of tighter Bank of Japan policy and widespread speculation that the Japanese government may intervene in the FX market again. The financial markets are almost certain that the BoJ will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 18, and traders also think BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda may hint at further policy normalization before year‑end.

Adam Turnquist, technology strategist at LPL Financial, said on Tuesday, "The yen’s rally reflects a real shift in fundamentals and technicals, with the BoJ moving further toward policy normalization and breaking its previous trend. Investors should watch the key level of 152 closely; if the yen decisively breaks that support and appreciates further, it could accelerate the rally, force more short covering, and reignite the risk of yen‑carry‑trade unwind, which could have cascading effects on global assets, including U.S. Treasuries."

Official data released earlier this week showed that Japan’s August foreign‑securities holdings fell by a record $87.8 billion. The sharp drop in foreign‑exchange reserves directly funds Tokyo’s ¥15 trillion (about $97.67 billion) FX‑intervention capacity, some of which is coordinated with the United States.
Among other currencies, the euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1629.
The ECB is almost unanimously expected by the market to raise rates by 25 basis points on Thursday.

Jim Reid of Deutsche Bank said, "The market can indeed discuss whether, under a supply shock, the ECB should keep raising rates… but the market clearly sees the ECB’s policy response function as highly linked to energy prices. Recent spikes in oil and gas have pushed market pricing of the final rate to about 3%."

He added, "Therefore, a rate hike tomorrow is basically a given, but what follows will become more complex. If energy prices stay at current levels, economic growth should be affected, but so far the real impact has been far less than markets originally expected, so the high uncertainty facing the ECB must be taken seriously."

items.title: 日元強勢反攻！日本升息恐掀套利交易平倉 美股、AI科技股小心了
items.title_en: Yen’s Strong Rebound! Japan Rate Hike Could Trigger Arbitrage Unwinding, Watch US Stocks and AI Tech Shares
paras: 日元近期大幅升值，兌美元價位從160一路升破153，然而策略師警告，若日元繼續走強並造成「套利交易」快速平倉，可能引發股市拋售，而高估值的美國科技股將首當其衝。
多年來，華爾街交易員熱愛能「輕鬆賺錢」的「日元套利交易」：以近乎零利率的成本在日本借錢，再把資金投入其他市場追逐更高報酬，主要流向美股市場。
但這項押注如今面臨瓦解風險，近期日元兌美元大幅升值，加上市場普遍預期日本銀行(BOJ, 央行)下周升息，可能重創這項廣受歡迎的交易策略。
日元周二(8日)延續兌美元升勢，盤中一度升破153，最高報152.89日元兌1美元，創2月以來最強。
市場預期日銀下周將大幅升息，成為推動日元上漲的主要動力。市場也開始揣測，日本當局可能再次低調干預外匯市場，以抑制日元近期跌勢。
日元兌美元上周已跌破160整數關卡。160通常被視為關鍵門檻，日元一旦升至這一水準，日本政府干預匯市的可能性將提高。根據FactSet數據，日元兌美元9月迄今已升值近4%。
在此背景下，市場動能可能讓股市投資人暴露在一項意料之外的衝擊中：日元持續升值，進而引發套利交易快速平倉。
所謂套利交易，是指投資人以較低利率借入資金，再投入可能帶來較高報酬的資產。日元套利交易則是借入低收益的日元，買進收益率較高的美元，再將美元投入美國資產，例如科技股。
舉例來說，1年期日本政府公債殖利率約1.55%，1年期美國國庫券殖利率約4.12%，兩者相差約2.57個百分點。換句話說，日元套利交易可藉由這項利差提高投資報酬。
但這項交易也可能以同樣強大的力量反向運作。如果日元突然進一步升值，就像近幾天的走勢一樣，投資人可能被迫迅速解除套利部位。這意味著投資人可能必須賣出以美元計價的資產，再將資金換回日元，以償還以日元計價的借款。
市場不久前就曾承受這種痛楚。2024年夏季日元大幅升值，引發股市震盪，套利交易平倉尤其威脅當時漲勢凌厲的美國科技股。
如今外匯市場可能再次具備類似條件。市場預期日銀將升息，而單是升息預期本身就可能進一步推升日元。
Swissquote資深分析師Ipek Ozkardeskaya表示，這類套利交易平倉「可能對AI／科技股族群造成尤其嚴重的衝擊」，因為高估值與部位過度集中，可能放大潛在的拋售壓力。
她指出，這將為逢低買進創造機會，因為套利交易平倉不會永遠持續，但短期內——可能持續數周，投資人將感受到壓力。
不過，Clocktower Group首席市場策略師Eric Wallerstein認為，這一次日元套利交易出現系統性平倉的可能性不高，因為交易員大多已經預期日元今年還會進一步升值。因此，日元若再突然升值，較不容易讓交易員措手不及，這或許足以避免出現恐慌性的大規模平倉。
Wallerstein表示，只要日本利率仍遠低於全球其他地區，「套利交易就仍會存在」。但若要重演幾年前出現的劇烈震盪，日元必須出現「幅度大且出乎意料」的升值。
2024年夏季套利交易平倉期間，日元兌美元在短短兩個月內升值13%。相比之下，這一次自7月底美元兌日元匯率觸及高點以來，美元兌日元匯率貶值不到6%。
paras_en: The yen has surged sharply lately, climbing from around 160 per dollar to break below 153, but strategists warn that if the yen keeps strengthening and forces a rapid unwind of “arbitrage trades,” it could spark a stock‑market sell‑off, with over‑valued US tech stocks hit first.

For years Wall Street traders have loved the easy‑money “yen arbitrage” play: borrow at near‑zero rates in Japan and deploy the funds into other markets for higher returns, mainly flowing into US equities.

That bet now faces collapse risk as the yen has appreciated sharply against the dollar and markets broadly expect the Bank of Japan to raise rates next week, which could cripple this popular strategy.
The yen continued its rise against the dollar on Tuesday the 8th, briefly breaking the 153 level and peaking at ¥152.89 per $1, its strongest since February.

Markets anticipate a sizable BOJ rate hike next week, the main driver behind the yen’s climb, and are also speculating that Japanese authorities may quietly intervene in FX to curb the yen’s recent rally.

Last week the yen fell below the round‑number barrier of 160 per dollar. The 160 level is seen as a key threshold; once the yen reaches it, the likelihood of government FX intervention rises. FactSet data shows the yen has appreciated about 4% against the dollar so far in September.
Against this backdrop, market momentum could expose equity investors to an unexpected shock: a continuously strengthening yen that triggers a rapid unwind of arbitrage positions.

Arbitrage trades involve borrowing at low rates and investing in higher‑yielding assets. Yen arbitrage means borrowing cheap yen, buying higher‑yielding dollars, and deploying those dollars into US assets such as tech stocks.

For example, the 1‑year Japanese government bond yields about 1.55% while the 1‑year US Treasury yields about 4.12%, a spread of roughly 2.57 percentage points, allowing yen arbitrage to boost investment returns.

But the same mechanism can work in reverse. If the yen suddenly appreciates further, as it has in recent days, investors may be forced to unwind arbitrage positions quickly, selling dollar‑denominated assets and converting the proceeds back to yen to repay yen‑denominated loans.
The market felt this pain not long ago. In the summer of 2024 a sharp yen rally rattled equities, and the unwinding of arbitrage trades especially threatened the then‑soaring US tech sector.
Now the FX market may again present similar conditions. Expectations of a BOJ rate hike alone could further lift the yen.
Swissquote senior analyst Ipek Ozkardeskaya said such arbitrage unwinds “could hit AI/tech stocks especially hard” because high valuations and concentrated positions can amplify sell‑pressure.
She added that this could create buying opportunities on dips, since arbitrage unwinds won’t last forever, but in the short term—potentially for several weeks—investors will feel the strain.

However, Clocktower Group chief market strategist Eric Wallerstein believes the chance of a systemic unwind this time is low, as traders largely anticipate further yen gains this year, making a sudden move less likely to catch them off guard and possibly averting panic‑driven mass unwinds.

Wallerstein noted that as long as Japanese rates remain far below those elsewhere, “arbitrage trades will persist.” Yet to repeat the severe volatility seen a few years ago, the yen would need to appreciate “dramatically and unexpectedly.”

During the summer 2024 unwind, the yen rose 13% against the dollar in just two months. By contrast, since the end of July when the USD/JPY peaked, the dollar has depreciated less than 6% against the yen.
